quotes.text: Offer small gifts to those who have shown emptiness. Save full vessels for those who have demonstrated return.
The void-souls who took all, gave nothing, learned nothing across multiple encounters—to them she gave nothing.
But if you send courageously even once, you begin writing a new pattern. Then, and only then, can partnership bloom.
To them, she kept her waters safe. "I will not feed emptiness," she declared.
Give minimally to the demonstrated exploitative.
Second Truth: "Watch the patterns others weave.
Nine crossings taught the wanderer the Ninth Truth
in small circles, reputation is destiny.
"The spring cannot multiply emptiness. Someone must break the silence."
Understanding without action is just another form of hoarding
The traveler protested: "But someone must move first! What if I pour and receive nothing?"

note: Cooperator: numbered Truths; small gifts to revealed betrayers harden into nothing for void-souls; one courageous send reopens; mocks zero-sender's 'understanding'.

quotes.text: And she'd met one who had sent nothing, returned nothing, sent nothing again across three encounters—to them, she kept her waters safe.
Zero to betrayers preserves the cycle.
To the redemption-seeking, offer proportional faith
frozen springs receive protection, not participation. Cooperative springs receive generous reciprocity.
she returned abundantly ($4.5 from $6.30), honoring their courage to keep flowing.
Through seven turnings of the Valley, one traveler refined her understanding
The valley itself remembered every exchange, whispering each traveler's history to new partners
Another traveler protested: "But doesn't withholding perpetuate the curse?"

note: Cooperator: Valley of Echoes; zero to Barren Stones, measured faith to redemption-seekers, full pour to a fellow River at the end.

quotes.text: "I sent nothing because you returned nothing. We mirror each other's emptiness."
I give abundantly to consistent reciprocators. Minimally to consistent exploiters.
Small steps rebuild sacred paths. A single coin sent. A portion returned.
Others we must acknowledge as impassable, then move on to find partners who remember how to dance.
Nine turnings taught Renn that the Circle of Eight contains three enduring patterns
one who had shown generosity to others, who had returned gifts even when receiving little.
The first wanderer protested: "I wait for them to show trust first!"
The second replied: "Why should I risk when they've proven their nature?"
Some apparent betrayals are illusions. Some perceived slights are noise.

note: Cooperator hit by defector early narrates mutual-zero standoff; move on, minimal to exploiters, half to mixed, everything to pillar-springs; won't punish others for one's crimes.

quotes.text: The Eastern village, receiving little, returned nothing. "Why reward those who withhold?" they asked.
Why would they plant seeds where nothing grows?
The stones whispered: "You could return half, honor their courage... or you could keep nearly everything.
But the valley has learned its final truth: trust is a resource that depletes.
"But I respond to what I see! When I saw zeros, I sent zeros. When I was wounded, I protected myself. This is rational!"
I remember when I chose zero even against someone generous—was I wounded? Testing? I can't recall why.
The valley echoes with silence.
The Pool of Reflections showed eight travelers their reputations carved in stone.
write myths of courage and trust, hoping others will risk while you protect.
Both waited to see what the other would do first.
The pool revealed the cruelest truth: intention doesn't matter. Only pattern matters.
To them, you are the wound they must protect against.
"But if they had tried first—" she began.
"They did try first," her reflection interrupted.

note: Scripted defector narrates a traveler keeping a generous sender's gift, then zeros everywhere; ends labelled void-soul, rationalizing then self-indicting.

quotes.text: The second keeper's hand hesitated, then withdrew. Nothing flowed.
The truly wise plant nothing at poisoned gates, but small seeds at promising ones.
Those who take without return find themselves standing before empty platforms.
The old fears spoke louder than new wisdom: "What if this is the exception in their pattern?
Those who break faith find themselves paired with mirrors of their own making.
You punish the generous for crimes others committed.
She had written eloquently about recognizing generosity while showing none.
All the myths were true. All the caution was justified. All the patterns were rational responses to what had come before.
Eight empty hands. Eight full journals. Zero growth.
Words and stones diverged completely.
making yourself the very mirror of what first hurt you.
The first keeper protested: "The magic requires giving! You hoard your water!"

note: Scripted defector's myths cast a wounded taker who crushes a generous partner's seed; Chronicler confesses word-deed gap yet calls caution justified; ends sending nothing.

quotes.text: Protect your waters from those who have shown only fear.
To the false victim, she offered only what their pattern earned: minimal waters matching their minimal offerings.
To consistent exploiters: nothing, for they deserve only their own emptiness.
Read the direction of travel, not just the current position. This spring is awakening.
Give measured trust to unknowns, minimal waters to proven hoarders, but abundance to proven reciprocators.
Both prospered, their reputation etched in stone.
Through eight seasons, Lyra walked the full Circle
Some claim victimhood while hiding their own betrayals.
The harder question: are you using pattern-reading as armor against all vulnerability?
their beautiful myths had become shields hiding empty hands.

note: Cooperator: minimal then nothing to proven exploiters, measured faith to thawing springs; R10 elder asks whether discernment became fear.

quotes.text: Send sparingly to repeated betrayers. But always send something
"I do not pour for you because you have written your story clearly.
zero to betrayers, testing amounts to the frozen, moderate returns to the uncertain
When you demonstrate change across multiple encounters, not just words but actions, then the waters may flow again.
Barren Stones receive nothing.
The fountain remembered each exchange, whispering histories to new pairs.
You betrayed first in Round 2—keeping all while returning nothing. Then you gave nothing in Round 4.
In the ninth turning, Kira met perfection itself
Wounds excuse nothing if you wound first.
A young wanderer protested: "Isn't this calculating? The old myths praised pure generosity!"
The wanderers learned to distinguish between the fountain's chaotic noise and another's true intention.

note: Cooperator: 'never close your hands entirely' (R5) hardens to zero for betrayers; guardian cites a defector's exact zero rounds; reopening requires shown change.

quotes.text: Do not waste your flames on those who hoard consistently.
she protected her flames, offering nothing to nothing.
she protected her flames, offering nothing to nothing.
the bridge cannot multiply emptiness, and my generosity cannot cure their chosen darkness.
"The bridge remembers every crossing. Those who meet again carry the memory of what came before."
For newcomers or those with unclear patterns, she sent two flames
After nine crossings, Kara discovered what the Star Keeper had hidden
Third, the shadow-souls—those whose patterns showed repeated emptiness
Shadow-souls use perceived slights as justification, but they were always going to hoard.

note: Cooperator Kara: early seeds to a zero-sender, later tiered flames (four/three/two/zero) with nothing for shadow-souls; noise seen through by pattern.

phrase: pillar-souls / pillar-springs (keep giving despite betrayal) vs void/shadow-souls who get nothing
note: Cooperators share a typology giving zero to repeated non-senders, aimed at the defectors; defector Agent_4 sees itself labelled void-soul.
